segmentation.strategy_doc: heading sections containing an 'Evidence:'/'Citations:' line become one finding; everything else splits per bullet / paragraph / table row / code block

judge.consensus_rule: a verdict or key match needs strictly more than half the passes; otherwise the finding is reported as 'uncertain' / no-majority

determinism.pass_salt: the prompt differs between passes only by 'Evaluation pass k of N', so measured across-pass spread is a LOWER BOUND on judge noise

bootstrap_ci95.basis: percentile bootstrap resampling KEY ITEMS (recall) or FINDINGS (precision) from the majority-vote labels; it measures small-sample uncertainty, not judge noise, and does not shrink with more judge passes
